title: Import a spritesheet into {id}
canvas: The sheet with the cell grid drawn over it
pick: Pick a PNG sheet to begin.
grid: {cols} × {rows} cells in a {w}×{h} sheet; {n} will be imported.
leftover: Left over: {x} px at the right, {y} px at the bottom.
existing: {clip} has {n} frames. Existing frame numbers here: {have}.
mode: What to do with frames that exist
mode.append: Append: start after the last frame
mode.note: A frame that exists gets a new pending revision and keeps its old pixels; only a person approves it. Nothing is written into shipped files.
willAdd: These frames will be added as raw frames with provenance.
willRevise: Existing frames will get a new pending revision; new frames are added with provenance.
doneNote: They wait for review in the Review tab; nothing is approved.
tooBig: The sheet is larger than {max} KiB.
unreadable: That file is not a PNG this browser can read.
